description: This file defines the access control handler class for taxonomy term entities in Drupal, managing permissions for viewing, updating, deleting, and revising taxonomy terms.

classes.name: TermAccessControlHandler
classes.description: Defines the access control handler for taxonomy term entities, extending Drupal's EntityAccessControlHandler to implement permission checks for taxonomy terms.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for various operations (view, update, delete, revision management) on taxonomy term entities based on user permissions.

methods.name: checkCreateAccess
methods.description: Determines if a user has permission to create taxonomy terms in a given bundle.
